summary: Describes the TLS cipher suites built on single DES and IDEA, which were defined for TLS 1.0 and 1.1 and dropped from TLS 1.2. It records them for completeness and explains why they should no longer be used. This document is historic and was replaced by RFC 8996.

eli5.summary: Long ago, computers locked their messages with two old kinds of padlock. This note keeps a record of how those locks worked, but says they are too easy to pick now, so nobody should use them.

questions: why were des and idea removed from tls
what are the des cipher suites in tls
